Once the foreign supplier holds back its shipments, local producers step in with substitutes to capture the market, and that surge of domestic competition tends to pull the price of the good down.

Meshed gears share the same tooth speed at their contact point, since each tooth pushes exactly one tooth along, so the linear motion passed to the wheel matches the motor's and nothing is really sped up.

At 10 nm a particle diffuses far more freely and drops near the size the kidneys can filter, so random thermal motion and renal clearance take over how it spreads and leaves the body.

By Kepler's third law the period squared goes as the distance cubed, so four cubed is 64, and the square root of 64 is 8, giving an orbit of 8 Earth years.

The signal weakens as it travels under the myelin, so the nodes act as boosting stations, producing chemical messengers inside the cell that strengthen the impulse before it moves to the next segment.

Constant velocity means no acceleration at all, and by Newton's second law the net force equals mass times acceleration, so all the forces on the object must cancel to nothing.

A creature that evolves under triple gravity has to be built for it, so for the same body plan the load per unit of support shrinks to a third, leaving it at 200 N.

Independent failures multiply, so the chance all three miss the fault at once is 0.1 times 0.1 times 0.1, which comes to 0.001, and that is the point of the redundancy.

A coherent state is the most classical light there is, with a well-defined amplitude and small symmetric fluctuations, so the photon counts form a bell curve centered on the mean of alpha squared.

Stick-slip means the fault sticks for long periods while the rock around it bends and stores elastic strain, and then slips all at once when the stress overcomes friction, releasing that energy.
